validity: A signature by a key is valid for an object whose timestamp (snapshot generated_at, receipt ts) lies in [valid_from, valid_until). Retired keys stay listed so old snapshots and receipts keep verifying; they sign nothing new. sha256_fingerprint = sha256 of the raw 32-byte public key.

keys.signs: dataset snapshots (/dataset.json bytes, see /dataset.sig.json) and paid test-buy receipts (canonical JSON of the receipt without its sig field)
keys.note: Production key. It will be rotated before valid_until; a new key_id is added first.

keys.signs: each cron-probe receipt, daily_aggregate and archive manifest: canonical JSON of the object without its sig field (keys sorted, no whitespace)
dataset snapshots generated before retired_at (/dataset.json bytes, /dataset.sig.json); verify only
keys.note: Retired but valid: verifies snapshots generated before retired_at (for example the dated copies under /archive/dataset/). It signs nothing new.
